name: Global Polynomial Obfuscation
description: The local binary constraint (s_u != s_v) is transformed into a single global polynomial equation over all variables. By expanding the sum of a strictly non-negative polynomial (which evaluates to 0 iff the local constraint holds for all edges) into node-degree sums and edge-product sums, the local structure is completely hidden. Models that attempt to satisfy the global equation directly via SMT or unpruned backtracking will TLE. To succeed, the model must symbolically factor the global polynomial back into the sum of local non-negative terms and deduce the equivalent 3-coloring graph constraint.
